verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions a Privacy Portal that can 'detect and classify customer data', a general privacy-tool suite, and consent management. None of it documents per-destination hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. Classification and consent enforcement are adjacent controls, and Functions are a developer building block for writing custom JavaScript, so none of these earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes
